memos_so_far.headline: Blackstone is the lender, not the target: $300M of debt for someone else's buyout, 0.3% of BX
reasoning: Source: Benzinga 18:02 UTC citing MarketScreener, 'Blackstone Leads $300 Million Debt Financing for Gooch & Housego Buyout'. Quoted: 'Blackstone has reportedly led a $300 million debt financing package to support the buyout of Gooch & Housego.' 'Reportedly': no Blackstone release; UNCONFIRMED.
What changed for Blackstone: one private-credit loan of $300M, against an $87.4B market value and a credit business that writes deals like this every week.
'Buyout' in the headline scored it 3 under the rule for companies being bought; here the buyout is of Gooch & Housego, a UK company, by someone else.
objections: Immaterial: a reported $300M loan by a $87B asset manager; the buyout target is another company.
